changes.title: Goodwill Impairment Charges

changes.year1_quote: We test goodwill for impairment on an annual basis, or more frequently, if necessary. A significant decline in our expected future cash flows, a material change in interest rates, a significant adverse change in the business climate, slower growth rates, or a significant or sustained decline in the price of our common stock may necessitate taking future charges related to the impairment of goodwill.
changes.year2_quote_or_null: We test goodwill for impairment on an annual basis, or more frequently, if necessary. A significant decline in our expected future cash flows, a material change in interest rates, a significant adverse change in the business climate, slower growth rates, or a significant or sustained decline in the price of our common stock may necessitate taking future charges related to the impairment of goodwill.
changes.reasoning: The Year-2023 disclosure retains the same underlying economic risk: specified adverse conditions may trigger a significant goodwill impairment charge that could harm earnings and capital/equity. The added sentence clarifies the effect on stockholders’ equity but does not weaken, remove, or materially alter the risk.
